publication.title: [v0.92.2][C-SDLC v3] Align validator admission and allow typed plan correction
publication.body:
Closes #984

## Summary
- align prepare-time validator admission with semantic proof admission
- allow typed validator-only plan correction with no-op handling for identical edits
- recover interrupted validator edit reservations and apply retained validators exactly once

## Validation
- cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --test installed_intent_commands installed_prepare_rejects_validators_that_proof_would_not_admit
- cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --test installed_intent_commands installed_edit_can_correct_validators_with_a_single_cargo_filter
- cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --test installed_intent_commands installed_recover_reconciles_interrupted_validator_edit
- cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --check
- cargo check --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml
